description: Land Acquisition - Mathugobe, Kotapola D/S Division, Matara District - Amendment to the notice published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1911/4 of 21.04.2015 by Devinuwara D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains declarations for acquiring specific parcels of land (including detailed descriptions of land boundaries, extents, and locations) for public purposes. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative procedures without involving government personnel changes, structural reorganizations, or other specialized categories.
